description: This Java class defines a REST API endpoint for User-related operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting users within a web application built with Spring Framework.

classes.name: UserRestEndpoint
classes.description: A REST controller exposing user-related endpoints for get, create, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a user by userId.

methods.name: createNewUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new user from provided UserResource.

methods.name: updateExistingUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update an existing user from provided UserResource.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a user by userId.
